units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 16:21">Targ. Jud. XVI, 21</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 23:1">Pesik. R. s. 23-24</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:7:10">Y. Kidd. I, 61ᵇ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:26">Y. Peah I, 15ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>טְחוֹן תחותי</he> grind thou in my place.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:26">Ib.</cite> <he>הוה איטחין</he>, read: <he>הוה טָחֵין</he> as Y. Kidd. l. c.—
Snh. 96ᵃ טַחְנֵי קשייתא were grinding date-stones; a. fr.—Part. pass. טְחִין, טְחִינָא.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 96b">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>טְחִינַת קמחא ט׳</he> thou groundest ground flour (you conquered Israel because it was doomed to destruction).
<cite ref="Berakhot 43a:19">Ber. 43ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>משחא ט׳</he> oil perfumed with ground ingredients, contrad. to <cite ref="K00055"><he>כבישא</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 6:10:2">Y. Ned. VI, end, 40ᵃ</cite> <he>קליין וטְחִינָן וכ׳</he> roasted and ground &c. [<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:16:3">Cant. R. to I, 16</cite> <he>לא מטחנא</he>, read: <he>מְטַמְּנָא</he> (?), v. <cite ref="N01136"><he>נְצַע</he></cite>.]
